d:
Fall in love with the beautiful title song “Chori Chori Chupke Chupke” featuring Salman Khan and Preity Zinta! Enjoy this melodious Bollywood romantic song from the film Chori Chori Chupke Chupke, brought to life by the soulful voices of Babul Supriyo and Alka Yagnik.
Chori Chori Chupke Chupke -Title Song | Salman Khan & Preity Zinta Hits | Babul Supriyo, Alka Yagnik
Song: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke (Title Song)
Movie: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke (2001)
Star Cast: Salman Khan, Preity Zinta, Rani Mukherjee
Singers: Alka Yagnik, Babul Supriyo
Music Director: Anu Malik
Lyricist: Sameer
